read.en: Microsoft fell 1.1% on Nov 16 to $517.99, trading $516.83–527.95. It is below the 5-day ($523.8) and 10-day ($530.8), both falling, and the 30-day ($530.3, rising), and above the 100-day ($481.8) and 200-day ($441.9). MACD has been below its signal since Nov 10, above zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Nov 4 ($513.05), and RSI is 46.4.
read.zh: 微软 11月16日下跌 1.1%，收于 $517.99，盘中区间 $516.83–527.95。股价位于 5 日（$523.8）和 10 日均线（$530.8，二者均下行）以及 30 日均线（$530.3，上行）下方，位于 100 日（$481.8）和 200 日均线（$441.9）上方。MACD 自 11月10日起位于信号线下方，在零轴上方，柱状图放大；抛物线 SAR 自 11月4日起看多（$513.05），RSI 为 46.4。

read.en: The close broke the $518.5–521 support (Nov 11 low, Nov 3 close), now resistance; the $516.83 low held above the Nov 13 low ($513.82) and the SAR. Resistance is $518.5–523.9, then $524.5–530.8 (10 and 30-day) and $533.2–534.8. Support is $513–513.8 (SAR, Nov 13 low), then $505–507.8 (Nov 2–3 lows) and $486 (Sep 10 low). A close above $523.9 would target $528–531; below $513, the SAR would flip bearish.
